item: A Stop pressed and cleared inside a request is still a Stop in the other recorders: the feed pass, crawl rung, archive backfill, preflights, calendar feeds and the source health count (R614, second PR)
summary: R614 (3), the follow-up to PR #1849 (the engagement epoch: kill_switch_epoch() before a request, kill_switch_engaged_since(epoch) after it). Each of these recorders decided after its request by reading the kill switch (R320), so a Stop pressed and cleared again inside the request's flight was stored as the target's behaviour: the feed pass stored the feed's validator past an entry the Stop cut (the next pass got a 304 and never asked for it) and climbed or erased its backoff; the crawl rung stamped the outlet crawled, or fell back to a blind crawl after a discovery the Stop cut short; the archive backfill recorded a cut enumeration as an empty history and consumed a cut URL; the source preflight, the feed preflight and the calendar feed verification logged the host or feed as unreachable (a calendar feed then climbs the re-check ladder, a month per rung); the calendar auto-import counted the feed failed and stamped it (12 h away); and the source health count filed a probe refused by name as down. Each now takes the epoch before its request and asks kill_switch_engaged_since(epoch) where it read the switch. The feed pass's window is the whole pass from before the feed GET to its bookkeeping, and an entry's failure reason uses its own window; the crawl rung's window is one outlet's step, and on a Stop, cleared or not, the rung ends its step for the pass as when the switch is still engaged; the backfill judges each URL by its own window. The health count takes the epoch before the probes: a detail that starts with the fetcher's own refusal sentence is the switch's whatever the switch reads now (the security read's note on PR #1849), and the wrapped guard sentence counts only when a Stop touched the sweep. Gates that decide whether to make a request (the loop heads) still read the switch as it is now, and each window opens BEFORE the check that lets its request go, so a Stop in the instant between the two is in it (found by the R617 audit, three cases pin it). Not covered here, R617: the markets CSV feeds and pipeline, the qualification trial (sitemap_trial_ingest, no check after its requests) and an audit of the wiki, stats, hazards and catalog jobs. tests/test_kill_switch_epoch_readers.py (34 cases) drives the production fetcher with the airplane socket guard armed (or each recorder's own seam), a Stop pressed and cleared inside each request, and a control with no Stop for each recorder; 26 of 26 mutants are killed, and the three order cases are each killed by putting the capture back after the check. One independent read: one blocker (the health count trusted words a host can write in a status line; also fixed at the root by R616) and one missed recorder (the calendar auto-import), both fixed. Release-notes line: pressing Stop and going back online while a collection pass, a crawl, an archive backfill, a preflight or a calendar check was under way no longer marks the feed, outlet or host as failed or done.
